name: GNOME Taquin
tagline: Slide tiles to their correct places
blurb: Taquin is a computer version of the 15-puzzle and other sliding puzzles.
description:
Taquin is a computer version of the 15-puzzle and other sliding puzzles.

The object of Taquin is to move tiles so that they reach their places,
either indicated with numbers, or with parts of a great image.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
